verse.verse_1: By oath of those who harshly pull out the soul. (Of the disbeliever)
verse.verse_2: And who softly release the soul. (Of the believer)
verse.verse_6: On the day when the trembling one will tremble. (The disbelievers will certainly taste the punishment.)
verse.verse_7: And the following event will come after it.
verse.verse_8: Many a heart will flutter on that day!
verse.verse_10: The disbelievers say, “Will we really return to our former state?”
verse.verse_12: They said, “So this return is an obvious loss!”
verse.verse_13: So that is not but a single shout.
verse.verse_14: So they will immediately be in an open plain.
verse.verse_15: Did the news of Moosa reach you?
verse.verse_16: When his Lord called him in the holy valley of Tuwa.
verse.verse_17: That “Go to Firaun – he has rebelled.”
verse.verse_18: “Tell him ‘Do you have the inclination to become pure?’
verse.verse_19: ‘And I may guide you to your Lord, so that you may fear.’”
verse.verse_20: So Moosa showed him a magnificent sign.
verse.verse_21: In response, he denied and disobeyed.
verse.verse_22: He then turned away, striving in his effort.
verse.verse_23: So he gathered the people, and proclaimed.
verse.verse_24: And then said, “I am your most supreme lord.”
verse.verse_25: Allah therefore seized him, in the punishment of this world and the Hereafter.
verse.verse_26: Indeed in this is a lesson for one who fears.
verse.verse_27: Do you think that it is harder to create you or the heavens? Allah has created it.
verse.verse_28: He raised its roof and made it proper.
verse.verse_29: And He made its night dark, and started its light.
verse.verse_30: And after it spread out the earth.
verse.verse_31: And from it produced its water and its pasture.
verse.verse_33: In order to benefit you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: So when the greatest universal disaster arrives,
verse.verse_35: On that day man will recall all what he strove for.
verse.verse_36: And hell will be made visible to all those who can see.
verse.verse_39: Then indeed hell only is his destination.
verse.verse_40: And for one who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from desire,
verse.verse_41: Then indeed Paradise only is his destination.
verse.verse_42: They (the disbelievers) ask you regarding the Last Day, as to when is its appointed time.
verse.verse_43: What concern do you have regarding its explanation? (You are not bound to tell them)
verse.verse_44: Towards your Lord only is its conclusion.
verse.verse_45: You are but a Herald of Warning, for one who fears it.
verse.verse_46: The day when they will see it, it will seem as if they had not stayed on earth except for an evening or its morning.
